note: Swap the voice by changing this file only. bin/voice.mjs never changes when you swap an engine, and the default engine needs no API key.

edge.note: Read aloud by Microsoft Edge through node-edge-tts. Free, no API key, but it needs network.

local-tone.note: Not a voice: a low tone. It is here so the voice step can be checked with no network. Swap it for a real engine before you ship a video.
